name: mempalace
title_zh: 把项目与对话挖掘成一座可检索的记忆宫殿
tagline_zh: 问一句「上次那个方案后来怎么改的」，它从你散落的旧对话里把上下文捞回来——不用翻聊天记录，不用记得关键词。
tagline_en: Ask “how did we end up changing that plan?” and it digs the context out of your scattered old chats—no scrolling.
desc_en: MemPalace — mine projects and conversations into a searchable memory palace. Use when the user asks about MemPalace, memory palace, mining memories, searching memories, palace setup, wings, rooms, or drawers; or when they want to recall past work that may already be filed in their palace.
why_zh: 不是全文搜索，而是按翼、房间、抽屉分层归档，检索时沿结构走，命中率比关键词高一个量级。
why_en: Not a full-text search—it files memories into wings, rooms, and drawers, so recall follows structure, beating keyword matching.
limit_zh: 只挖本机已存在的项目与对话，不接云端；新建对话不会自动入库，需显式触发挖掘；检索结果止于「找到片段」。
limit_en: Mines only local existing projects/chats, no cloud; new conversations aren't filed unless explicitly mined; retrieval returns fragments, not full.
